description: Shell script for testing 'upload-pack ref-in-want' functionality in Git, including repository setup, fetch command testing, and server behavior simulation.

methods.name: get_actual_refs
methods.description: Extracts actual refs from output using sed and test-tool pkt-line unpack.

methods.name: get_actual_commits
methods.description: Processes output to extract commit hashes, verify pack, and sort commits.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Runs get_actual_refs and get_actual_commits, compares with expected refs and commits.

methods.name: write_command
methods.description: Outputs a command string and object format based on test_oid algo.

methods.name: write_fetch_command
methods.description: Constructs a fetch command with want-ref, have, and protocol-specific markers.

methods.name: inconsistency
methods.description: Simulates server reporting inconsistent refs during negotiation.
